page.layout: One column of text, full width. Division heading "EPIST. LXXV." centred at top, then the letter title in larger roman and italic, then the greeting line, then the body paragraph. No marginal notes. Catchword "Calum-" at lower right, below the last line. Running head "Jo. Morinus" at top, page number "580" at top left.

main_text.head: EPIST. LXXV.

J. Morinus Card. Barberino. Apologia Domini Feronii Canonici, & Archi-diaconi Ecclesiæ Carnutensis ac Do-ctoris Sorbonici, cui summus Ponti-fex concedere noluerat diplomata Bullarum Abbatiæ Sti Laudomari Ble-sensis, eó quòd doctor ille ob Janse-nianas opiniones apud Aulicos urbis male audierat.
main_text.p: Eminentissimo Cardinali Francisco Bar-berino J. Morinus S.P.D.

FAma non vulgarihîc increbuit, sanctissimum Dominum nostrum diplomata suis Bullis Abbatiæ S. Laudomari Blesensis concedere nolle in favorem viri admodum reverendi, & apud nos celebris; Domini FeroniiCanonici & Archidiaconi Carnutensis Ecclesiæ, Doctoris Sorbonici, & Illustrissimi Carnutensis vicarii & officialis ad eam regendam summo Pontifici à rege nominati, eo quòd Cornelii Jansenii Iprensis librum cui titulus est Augustinus, suffragio suo comprobaverit

page.notes: No marginal notes printed. Long s rendered as plain s throughout. The initial "F" of "Fama" is a large initial and is joined to the first word. The heading "J." is an ornamental J-like glyph, rendered as J. The word "FeroniiCanonici" is printed without a space and is kept as printed. The v in "qvòd" stands for u and is written quòd. Shown-through text and scan edges on the right were left out.
